column1: # The toolchain images a project can be built with, oldest first. tools/check builds the builder FROM the one a lock
# names (with --lock), else FROM the newest for the project's language: the last row that lists it. A row is added
# only once its image is published.
# ubsan says how its UBSan builds choose their checks: fixed, the release's fixed flags (a project may not set
# ubsan_checks), or checks, the project's ubsan_checks or the default (docs/project-yaml.md#ubsan_checks).
# languages are the values of project.yaml's language that it builds (docs/project-yaml.md#language).
